_comment: What each generated cell IS. The `subject` string is the only part of the prompt that changes between cells -- see design_ideas/art_direction.md Stage 2. `control` names the Stage-0 render in tmp/shots that seeds it; a cell with no control is generated without a composition reference (the anchors only).

framing.roster: Single object, three-quarter view, centred on a plain neutral mid-grey ground plane, plain soft background, even studio lighting, full object visible with margin on all sides. Square image.
framing.action: Wide gameplay shot seen from a fixed camera above and behind the party, looking down the bridge at about 45 degrees. The bridge is a raised structure in open air with nothing below it.
framing.anchor: A single establishing image that fixes the material logic of this style: one upright character, one stone pillar, one enemy and a patch of the bridge deck, arranged on a plain background. Even lighting, three-quarter view.

anchor_subject: A stout upright cylindrical character about 1.8 m tall with a small wedge on its front showing which way it faces, standing beside a waist-high round stone pillar and a small hostile cone-shaped creature, on a section of raised walkway deck.

roster.subject: A stout upright cylindrical character 1.8 m tall and 0.8 m across, flat-topped and flat-bottomed, in the party's blue colour, with a small bright wedge on its front face showing which way it is pointing. It is a playable hero, readable from above.
The same stout upright cylindrical character, in the party's amber colour instead of blue. The colour is the only difference: silhouette and proportions are identical to the blue one.
The same stout upright cylindrical character wearing a separate brimmed hat resting on its flat top. The hat must read as a distinct removable object sitting on the character, not as part of it.
A small brimmed hat lying by itself, a loose prop that can be knocked off a head and picked up by someone else.
A pickup that restores health: a small round object 0.7 m across, unmistakably a healing item and unmistakably good news.
A low mound of disturbed earth about 2 m across on a walkway deck, the telegraph that something hostile is about to burst out of it.
A round stone pillar block 1.6 m across and 2 m tall, flat-topped so a character can stand on it. It can be shoved one step sideways, and things bounce off it.
A heavy dark sphere 1.2 m across, the game's main hazard. It is slow, weighty and obviously dangerous, and must stay clearly visible against both a pale deck and an open sky.
A squat cylindrical emplacement 2 m wide with a short barrel on its top face, which lobs heavy balls up the bridge. It belongs to the pillar field it stands in, but is identifiably the dangerous one.
A hostile cone-shaped creature 1.4 m tall that bursts out of the ground and charges in a straight line. It dies in one hit. All of its design points forward.
A hostile humanoid enemy 1.7 m tall that keeps its distance and shoots. It must be distinguishable at a glance from the charging cone enemy and from the bolted-down turret.
A hostile gun emplacement 1.5 m wide bolted to the deck with a rotating top and a barrel. It cannot be shoved, and it must look immovable.
A single slow-moving projectile round about 0.3 m across with a visible tail, travelling left to right. Slow enough that a player watches it cross the gap.
A small rocket projectile 0.6 m long with an exhaust plume behind it, travelling left to right.
A small round thrown explosive 0.36 m across, lying armed on the ground.
A flat disc-shaped proximity mine 0.65 m across lying on the deck, with a single small sensor on top.
A pickup weapon lying on the deck: a compact rapid-fire gun with a barrel. One of five pickups that must be told apart by SHAPE alone at thirty metres, not by colour.
A pickup lying on the deck: a round thrown explosive with a grip. The only round one in the pickup set.
A pickup lying on the deck: a flat disc-shaped proximity mine, the flattest silhouette in the pickup set.
A pickup lying on the deck: a plantable shield panel. The only protective item in the game, and the only one that should read as cool rather than warm.
A pickup lying on the deck: a fat open-ended rocket launcher tube, wider than the other weapon pickups.

action.subject: Two of the cylindrical characters on a raised checkerboard walkway high in the air. One is mid-dash, committed and unable to steer, about to slam into the other, who is standing a few steps from a hole in the deck. Round stone pillars and a scattering of pickups sit around them.

A cylindrical character on a raised walkway with a heavy dark sphere arcing down through the air toward it, and a second sphere already rolling along the deck. Stone pillars, holes in the deck, and a drop into open sky on both sides.

Two cylindrical characters, one blue and one amber, standing together on a raised walkway as two hostile cone creatures charge at them from up the bridge, with a distant humanoid enemy shooting from behind. Stone pillars, holes in the deck, water on the level above.
